text: Residents have indicated that there have been issues between drivers and pedestrians in identifying right of way at this intersection and have requested an all way stop control in order to rectify this problem. Therefore, I request the installation of all-way stop control at the intersection of Oak Park Ave and Everett Crescent.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Oak Park Avenue and Everett Crescent.
